)

    ['git', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'm3: Deprecate None return in cachedmethod'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("git commit:", result.returncode)
if result.stderr:
    print("stderr:", result.stderr[:500])

# Verify all commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
